Class Design

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.Design
public final class Design extends Object
A root-level entry point that gathers the SDK's value-add design capabilities — Metro Optimizer, Deployment Wizard, Peering Intelligence, Savings Calculator, and TCO comparison — in one discoverable place, alongside the API-domain clients (Fabric, NetworkEdge, …).

Unlike those domain clients, Design is not constructed from credentials: it is a thin facade over an already-authenticated FabricGateway, which it reuses. This is intentional — the design engines run on top of an existing client (its metros, service profiles, prices, …) rather than opening a second connection pool / token. Construct it over your Fabric, or obtain one from a shared Equinix session via Equinix.design():

Design design = Design.over(fabric);          // reuses fabric's client — no new transport
OptimizationResult result = design.optimizeMetros()
        .addWorkload("ML Training").type(WorkloadType.AI_ML_TRAINING).bandwidthMbps(10_000).done()
        .optimize();
SavingsEstimate savings = design.savingsCalculator()
        .egress(50, DataUnit.TERABYTE).fromCloud(CloudProviderType.AWS).inRegion("us-east-1")
        .calculate();

Each method returns the same fluent builder you would get from the corresponding Fabric accessor (e.g. Fabric.optimizeMetros()) or the underlying *.builder(FabricGateway) factory. Export utilities (design.export.TerraformExporter, design.export.TopologyDiagram) operate on a produced plan/result and are used directly.
